mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening residential demand, which signals robust consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST has historically shown positive correlation with S&P 500 returns
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST shows a sustained upward trend (3-month rolling increase > 0.5%)

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tight labor market under monetary tightening, which increases corporate input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows negative returns when labor market tightens under policy tightening
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market tightness
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE falling and FEDFUNDS rising) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.03)

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5% YoY), a rising consumer price index accelerates expectations of further monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of high inflation regime periods (CPIAUCSL > 5% YoY) when CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS has a positive lead-lag relationship with S&P 500
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS shows a sustained upward trend (3-month rolling increase > 0.5%)

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial output, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO has historically led S&P 500 returns
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100

mechanism_narrative: In a slow growth regime (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1%), a declining GDP growth rate signals weak economic momentum, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of slow growth regime periods (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1%)

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) combined with falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a mismatch between residential demand and industrial output, which signals economic fragmentation and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows negative returns during demand-supply mismatches
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST rising and INDPRO falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.03)
